_note: Composite indices, mirroring the Zoom program's structure. Inputs are RingCentral-available metrics, so definitions differ from Zoom's even where the label matches. Each index is the mean of its available components' attainment; null when none are available.
_status: In production use since 2026-10. Each index is the mean of its available components' attainment, computed from the Scorecard rather than from a separate model, so it can always be explained to a customer. Components that are unavailable are dropped, not zeroed.

indices.label: CX Health Index
indices.note: Answer rate, abandon, routing hygiene and contact-centre staffing

indices.label: Automation Maturity Index
indices.note: AI insight coverage, IVR containment and recording discipline

indices.label: Deployment Health Index
indices.note: Provisioning hygiene, licence utilisation and emergency-address completeness
